opportunities.title: Coach House Safety Report
opportunities.description: I am converting a former coach house into a single-family dwelling. The fabric of the building will remain as it is—no walls removed, no roof alterations, no extensions—so the focus is squarely on an interior redesign. Before works can continue, Building Control has asked me for a full safety compliance report covering all applicable regulations for a change-of-use project. Here is what I need from you: • A thorough inspection (on-site or via detailed drawings and photos, whichever you can work with) of the existing structure, detailing how it meets or can be made to meet current Building Regulations, especially Parts A, B, E, F and K. • Clear recommendations for fire safety measures, means of escape, ventilation, insulation, and any required upgrades to plumbing and electrical layouts that arise from the interior redesign. • A professionally formatted Safety Compliance Report ready to submit to Building Control, with references to the relevant clauses, diagrams (AutoCAD/PDF), and a concise executive summary they can sign off. Acceptance criteria: the report must be accepted by Building Control with no major amendments. If minor clarifications are needed, you’ll update the document promptly. If you have previous UK change-of-use experience and can turn this around quickly, I’d love to hear how soon you can start and what information you need from me first.

opportunities.title: Residential 2D Architectural Plan Drafting
opportunities.description: I need a clean, well-organised 2D architectural set for a residential build. The focus is on two key drawings: a fully-dimensioned floor plan that shows walls, doors, windows, and fixed fixtures, and a coordinated interior design layout that clearly places furniture, cabinetry, and circulation paths. Please work in a professional CAD platform—AutoCAD, Revit (2D sheets), or a comparable tool—so I can receive both an editable DWG file and a ready-to-print PDF. Line weights, layer naming, and scale (1:100 metric preferred) should follow standard drafting conventions so the plans drop straight into council or contractor packages without extra cleanup. Deliverables: • Floor plan with dimensions, annotations, and room labels • Interior layout overlay indicating furniture, built-ins, and key finishes • DWG + PDF for each sheet, plus a plotted A3 set I will supply rough sketches and room requirements once we start. A quick turnaround, accurate dimensions, and willingness to adjust after the first review will be essential for approval.

opportunities.title: AI Agent for Office Automation
opportunities.description: # PROJECT REQUIREMENT: SOLARSEА AI BUSINESS AUTOMATION AGENT **Company:** SolarSea Electrotech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra, India **Deployment:** Office Windows Computer **Expected Volume:** 100–300 PM Surya Ghar registrations/month and 5–20 MSEDCL applications/day. ## 1. Project Overview SolarSea Electrotech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. wants to develop an AI-powered business automation agent that operates government portals through a web browser and automates repetitive administrative work associated with rooftop solar installations. The system should function like a virtual office assistant that reads customer documents, fills online forms, manages verification workflows, tracks applications and communicates with customers. The initial deployment will run on our office Windows computer, with the option to expand to multiple users later. ## 2. Main Requirements ### A. PM Surya Ghar Portal Automation Official portal: https://www.pmsuryaghar.gov.in/ The agent should: * Open and navigate the official portal. * Assist with customer registration and application forms. * Enter customer details and electricity consumer information. * Identify mandatory fields and validation errors. * Upload supporting documents where permitted. * Handle OTP and CAPTCHA checkpoints through authorized verification. * Resume the workflow after verification. * Record application numbers, status and submission receipts. * Track pending applications and required follow-ups. ### B. MSEDCL Application Automation Official portal: https://wss.mahadiscom.in/wss/wss Automate the following workflows wherever the portal permits: 1. New electricity connection applications. 2. Sanctioned-load enhancement applications. 3. Load reduction applications. The agent should enter applicant details, premises information, consumer number, existing and proposed load, and other required fields. It should validate entries, identify missing documents, upload files where supported and record application references. The agent must check the actual portal workflow before implementation and pause when manual verification or authorization is necessary. ### C. AI Document Processing The system should accept electricity bills, identity/address documents, PDFs and photographs. It should extract relevant information, including: * Customer name and address. * Electricity consumer number. * Sanctioned load and tariff category. * Billing information. * Other fields required by the selected application. The extracted information must be presented for verification. Missing or conflicting information must be flagged rather than guessed. ### D. Dedicated Mobile-Number Management SolarSea wants to investigate a system providing a separate, dedicated mobile number for each authorized PM Surya Ghar registration. **Target number retention: At least 90 days per customer registration.** Expected volume: 100–300 new registrations per month. The developer must: * Investigate legitimate Indian mobile-number and virtual-number providers. * Confirm whether the official portal permits company-managed numbers. * Verify that numbers can receive the required OTPs. * Confirm exclusive number assignment and 90-day retention. * Compare physical SIMs with suitable virtual-number services. * Develop a number inventory linked to customer and application records. * Track activation, assignment, expiry, renewal and release dates. * Prevent accidental reassignment while applications depend on a number. * Provide expiry alerts and an audit trail. Do not procure numbers in bulk before successfully testing a small batch. Shared public SMS inboxes and number arrangements that compromise account security are not acceptable. ### E. OTP and Verification Workflow The system should: * Detect when OTP verification is required. * Identify the registered destination where permitted. * Notify the authorized operator when verification is pending. * Integrate with approved SMS services where feasible. * Pause and resume the browser workflow. * Record verification status without retaining OTPs in ordinary logs or databases. The customer must authorize the registration arrangement and retain appropriate access to their account. The system must respect official portal rules and must not bypass CAPTCHA, authentication or other security controls. ### F. AI Calling and Customer Follow-ups Provide an optional AI voice agent supporting Marathi, Hindi and English, subject to provider capabilities. Features should include: * Outbound lead calls and inbound customer support. * Collection of missing application information. * Document reminders. * Quotation follow-ups. * Application-status updates. * Site-visit scheduling. * Escalation to a human employee. Calling and messaging must comply with applicable Indian telecom, consent and privacy requirements. ### G. opportunities.title: Freelance Sales Executive Needed
opportunities.description: I have a steady stream of warm leads coming in from our ongoing digital campaigns for KUDKYS Trading Co., and I need an experienced freelance Sales Executive who can jump on the phone, build quick rapport, and turn those inquiries into confirmed orders for our physical product line. opportunities.title: Commission-Based GoHighLevel Partner
opportunities.description: I’m ready to scale my GoHighLevel agency and need someone who can own the entire customer-acquisition cycle on a commission-only basis until a mutually agreed sales target is hit. The focus is on small, service-based businesses that can benefit from GoHighLevel’s all-in-one CRM, build website, chat bot, review reputation and automation suite. Here’s what you’ll be doing: • Generate qualified leads of service business owners and book discovery calls. • Record concise Loom walkthroughs that highlight our white-label dashboards and the tangible results current users are seeing. • Close accounts, then guide each new client through a smooth onboarding inside GoHighLevel, setting up snapshots, pipelines, automations, and basic training. • Provide ongoing email and chat support for the first 30 days so adoption sticks and churn stays low. We’ll track performance inside GoHighLevel itself, so every lead, presentation view, and deal stage is transparent. Once we reach the sales figure we agree on, we can switch to a fixed retainer, hybrid model, or keep the commission flowing—your call. If you already live inside GoHighLevel, can prospect quickly, and enjoy being paid directly in proportion to revenue you create, let’s talk about targets and percentages so we can start filling the pipeline right away.

opportunities.title: Gmail Business Lead-Gen Setup
opportunities.description: I want my Gmail Bisnis account (Google Workspace) configured so it actively produces more prospek penjualan, not just handles day-to-day email. My plan is to run kampanye email tersegmentasi to an existing customer list, so the environment has to make that simple, trackable, and compliant. Here is what I need from you: • Set up or refine the custom-domain Gmail mailbox, including security, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, signatures, labels, and filters tailored for segmented outreach. • Connect Gmail with a lightweight automation tool—GMass, Mailmeteor, Apps Script, or another option you recommend—so I can send personalized, volume-controlled batches without risking spam flags. • Build two sample segments from my pelanggan list and show me how to clone or edit them. • Create one reusable email template per segment, complete with merge tags and basic analytics (open/click tracking). • Provide a short, screen-recorded walkthrough so I can repeat the process for future campaigns. The setup is finished when I can import a CSV of customers, choose a segment, hit Send, and later view detailed results in either Gmail or the connected tool. If you have prior experience boosting sales leads through Gmail Bisnis, please mention the most relevant project and any metrics you achieved.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40778188, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: GoHighLevel Agency & Sub-Account Setup
opportunities.description: My agency runs on GoHighLevel and I need a specialist who can dive straight into the platform to streamline every layer—from the agency view down to individual client sub-accounts. Some of our legacy processes are already documented and partially built, others are still on paper, so the job is a blend of migrating what exists and building fresh, best-practice workflows where gaps remain. Core focus areas • Sub-account creation and configuration for new and existing clients • Agency-level management, including snapshots, reporting dashboards, and user permissions • Robust automation workflows that tie together CRM, marketing automation, and client communication tools (triggers, pipelines, email/SMS sequences, follow-up tasks) Deliverables & acceptance • Each client migrated or set up in its own sub-account with pipelines, calendars, and integrations functioning end-to-end • Agency dashboard cleaned up—custom fields standardized, reporting widgets accurate, and user roles correctly assigned • At least three reusable workflow templates that automate lead capture, nurture, and handover to sales, all fully tested • Handoff documentation (loom videos or step-by-steps) so my internal team can maintain and replicate what you build Access to our current SOPs, API keys, and brand assets will be provided on kickoff. Clear, concise communication is essential; please be comfortable sharing progress updates directly inside GHL or Slack.

opportunities.title: Spanish Dog Training Pads Packaging
opportunities.description: Necesito que nuestro nuevo paquete de pads entrenadores para perros luzca tan confiable como el producto mismo. El trabajo abarca dos presentaciones distintas, pero ambas deben compartir la misma línea visual premium y un estilo moderno y limpio que transmita calidad, higiene y confianza. Toda la información irá en español y, al frente, a los lados y al reverso del empaque, quiero que destaquen claramente el logotipo de la marca, los beneficios principales, el tamaño / cantidad de unidades, modo de uso, y la información de la empresa . Yo aportaré la paleta cromática oficial, así que solo tendrás que aplicarla de forma coherente y atractiva. Espero de ti: • Arte final listo para imprenta (AI + PDF con sangrados y troqueles). • Mockups realistas en 3D que permitan ver el empaque terminado desde varios ángulos. • Organización clara del layout: marca, tamaño, cantidad, beneficios y modo de uso. Experiencia previa en diseño de packaging es indispensable; adjunta ejemplos de trabajos similares en tu propuesta y comienza tu mensaje con la palabra “PACKAGING” para saber que leíste todo. Herramientas que suelo manejar: Adobe Illustrator para el arte y cualquier software de mockup 3D que prefieras (Dimension, Blender, Cinema 4D, etc.). Entrego de inmediato las medidas exactas y el manual de color una vez acordemos la colaboración.

opportunities.title: PHP E-Paper Site Customization
opportunities.description: I run the PHP-based news PDF e-paper at https://epaper.dharmaganta.com and have the full source code ready to share. I now want to refresh the site so it mirrors the smooth experience of paper.deshatimes.in while keeping my current backend intact. Front-end work The share bar needs replacing with polished buttons for Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp and a universal “share” icon. These buttons must adopt the new theme and function seamlessly on both desktop and mobile. Admin panel upgrades • Add straightforward controls that let me update the website header and footer—logo, menus, social links and any text—without touching code. • Provide a section to manage the “clip” graphic along with the header and footer graphics that appear inside each PDF page. • Integrate Google AdSense so I can paste ad code in the panel and pick its placement (header, between news blocks, sidebar) from a dropdown. UI redesign Deliver a clean, modern template inspired by the reference site but in my own colours. Only HTML/CSS/JS should change; core PHP logic stays the same. Deliverables • Updated theme files (HTML, CSS, JS, images) • Modified PHP modules/controllers enabling the new share bar, header/footer edits and AdSense settings • Any SQL or migration scripts if new tables or fields are added • A brief read-me explaining installation and where to find each new option in the admin panel Acceptance criteria The solution must run on PHP 8.* and MySQL 5.7+ without errors after I upload the files and import any database script. All new buttons, header/footer content and AdSense slots must be controllable from the back-office. I will provide full source code and cPanel access once milestones are agreed; please include your turnaround time and any similar e-paper or news portal work you have done.

opportunities.title: Advanced Telegram Assistant Using n8n -- 2
opportunities.description: Project Description: Designed and engineered an advanced, end-to-end automation pipeline utilizing n8n to build a smart Telegram assistant capable of processing user interactions dynamically. Key Workflow Features: Trigger & Input Handling: Listens to incoming user messages in real-time via a Telegram Trigger. Data Retrieval & Logging: Interacts with Google Sheets (Get row(s)) to fetch historical context or verify user data. Custom JavaScript Processing: Implements custom JS code nodes to format payloads, manipulate JSON data, and prepare contextual inputs. AI Integration: Connects via HTTP Request to the Google Gemini Generative AI API to generate intelligent, context-aware responses. Automated Multi-Channel Actions: Simultaneously dispatches the AI-generated reply back to the user via Telegram (Send a text message) while appending chat session details and activity logs into Google Sheets (Append row). Tech Stack: n 8 n Cloud | Telegram Bot API | Google Gemini API | Google Sheets API | JavaScript

opportunities.title: Defender Email Tracker Automation
opportunities.description: I need a hands-free workflow that pulls every newly reported email from Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and immediately reflects its current Status, Threat level and Action taken inside my existing Azure-hosted tracker. Here is how I picture it working: an Azure Function, Logic App or a well-structured PowerShell/Graph API script queries Defender on a schedule, identifies any messages that are not yet recorded (or whose state has changed), and then writes or updates the corresponding row in my Azure data store. The three columns that must stay accurate are: • Status of each email • Threat level • Action taken The solution should: • Authenticate securely with Defender (Modern OAuth, no hard-coded secrets) • De-duplicate entries so the tracker never shows the same message twice • Log every run and surface any failures in Azure Monitor (or another lightweight option you recommend) • Be packaged so I can deploy it to a new subscription in minutes, with clear step-by-step instructions Deliverables: 1. Complete source code / workflow definition 2. Deployment guide in Markdown 3. One short video or screenshots proving the tracker auto-updates after a test email is reported If you can add incremental enhancements—such as optional sender or attachment metadata extraction—please flag that in your proposal, but keep the core logic lean and reliable.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40778098, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Estrategia Retail Tienda Histórica
opportunities.description: Poseo una tienda con 61 años de historia que, a pesar de haber sido remodelada y duplicar la capacidad de exhibición, continúa sufriendo por bajas ventas. Busco a un profesional con experiencia demostrada en retail y en la creación de modelos de negocio que me acompañe a reposicionarla y devolverla a la rentabilidad. Situación actual • Local totalmente renovado, mayor espacio de sala de ventas. • Principal problema financiero: bajas ventas sostenidas. • Público objetivo: campesinos, agricultores, pequeños productores y transeúntes de la zona rural. • Nueva línea prevista: productos complementarios de veterinaria, agricultura y formato minisúper. Tienda ubicada en un lugar con alto tráfico de personas (cerca de la terminal de transporte de la ciudad) Tienda con una marca reconocida Lo que necesito de tu parte 1. Diagnóstico inicial apoyado en métricas de retail (tráfico, ticket promedio, GMROI). 2. Rediseño del modelo de negocio que defina surtido óptimo y mezcla de categorías, incluyendo la nueva propuesta veterinaria-agrícola. 3. Estrategia de precios, layout y experiencia en tienda pensando en mi público rural. 4. Plan de marketing integral (offline y digital) con acciones de lanzamiento y calendario de campañas. 5. Proyección financiera que muestre punto de equilibrio y escenarios de crecimiento. 6. Indicadores clave y hoja de ruta de implementación para los primeros 12 meses. Valoro entregables claros, análisis sustentado en datos y recomendaciones accionables. Si has liderado procesos de turnaround o reposicionamiento en retail, especialmente en mercados rurales o especializados, cuéntame tu experiencia: será decisivo para seleccionar al experto adecuado.

opportunities.title: Social Media Manager Bot
opportunities.description: I need an automated bot that runs my Tik and Facebook lricrs profiles as a full-time social media manager. The tool must publish fresh content every day, reply to comments and direct messages so the community stays active, and pull clear performance numbers I can review without digging through each platform. Key workflow • Content posting: queue, schedule, and publish reliably once a day on both platforms. • Engagement: identify new comments or DMs, respond with pre-written or AI-assisted replies, and flag anything that needs my personal touch. • Metrics: capture reach, impressions, follower growth, and top-performing posts, then export them to a Google Sheet or CSV I can check at a glance. Deliverables - Fully documented source code and install guide (Python, Node, or comparable language/tools welcome). - Configuration files showing the daily posting timetable for Tik and Facebook lricrs. - Engagement module with adjustable reply templates and basic keyword triggers. - Analytics export script feeding a simple dashboard or spreadsheet. - Quick-start guide so I can add new content queues or tweak settings without developer help. Acceptance criteria: first round of automated daily posts and an analytics report must run successfully on both accounts during hand-over, with clear evidence of engagement capture. If you have experience with social media APIs, headless browsers, or similar automation frameworks, this should be straightforward. I’m ready to review proposals that map out your approach and timeline.

opportunities.title: Blender NOOR Character Likeness Refinement
opportunities.description: I already have a fully rigged Blender file for NOOR, my interactive-healthcare AI avatar, but her face and body still need that last push toward true realism. Your task is to re-sculpt and re-topologise only where required so the model matches our photo references as closely as possible, without breaking the current facial-control or body-animation setup. Face The brief is holistic: every facial zone—from eyes and nose through lips, cheeks, jaw-line and cranial silhouette—must read as the same real woman. Feel free to iterate on topology or add corrective shapes; I simply need a convincing likeness that will hold up in close-ups, speech and expressive poses. Body All proportions need attention. Please refine chest, shoulders, arms, wrists, hands, fingers, hips, legs, feet and toes so they flow anatomically and match a 165 cm, 65 kg woman. The existing skeleton should remain usable; if you must adjust weights or bone placement, document the changes so my coders can update their animation calls. Skin & materials Update skin tone, micro-detail (pores, subtle wrinkles) and shader response so she behaves naturally under varied HDRI and studio lighting. Deliverables • Editable .blend file with revised geometry, UVs, textures, materials and any new normal/displacement maps • Front, profile, rear and three-quarter comparison renders in flat-grey and shaded modes • Short turntable + facial expression test to show deformations remain clean Workflow & milestones 1. Facial likeness approved first 2. Body refinement & anatomy pass 3. Final polish, demo renders and file hand-off When you reply, link to past realistic human characters—likeness projects are the most persuasive—outline your method, timeline, and separate fixed prices for face and full-body phases. Flag any paid add-ons or outsourced scans before work begins. My priority is a believable NOOR in the viewport, not just pretty stills. If that challenge excites you, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Integración Shopify Plus–Si-Nube
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir Shopify Plus en la plataforma central de mi operación: ahí los vendedores y clientes deberán cotizar productos y generar sus pedidos, mientras que toda la información se sincroniza en tiempo real con nuestro ERP Si-Nube. Lo que necesito de ti: • Configurar una integración bidireccional Shopify Plus ↔ Si-Nube con sincronización de datos en tiempo real (productos, precios, clientes, estatus de pedido). • Implementar dentro de Shopify Plus dos flujos clave: cotización de productos y levantamiento de pedidos. Ya cuento con funcionalidades específicas en mente; al iniciar el proyecto te compartiré el detalle para que puedas desarrollarlas o parametrizarlas. • Garantizar que la información fluya sin errores ni duplicados y quede lista para facturación y seguimiento desde el ERP. • Documentar la solución y capacitar brevemente a mi equipo para que pueda operar y escalar el sistema. Valoro la experiencia demostrable en Shopify Plus, APIs, webhooks y, de preferencia, proyectos previos con ERPs latinoamericanos. Si dominas Si-Nube o has realizado integraciones similares, mejor aún. Espero tu propuesta con tiempos estimados y tu enfoque técnico.

opportunities.title: Founding Operations Manager – Build and Manage Offshore Back-Office Services Team
opportunities.description: Long-Term Opportunity | Remote | Contract / Part-Time Initially About the Opportunity I am launching a U.S.-based managed business services company providing outsourced back-office operations to small and midsize businesses throughout the United States. Our planned services include bookkeeping support, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing administration, payroll coordination, general administration, CRM support, and business process automation. I am seeking an experienced Back-Office Operations Manager who can help establish and eventually lead our offshore service delivery operation. This is not a typical virtual assistant position. I am looking for someone with management experience who can help build a professional, scalable business. The right candidate could grow into a long-term leadership position as the company expands. This is a hands-on operations position, not a management-only role. During the initial startup phase, the selected candidate will be personally responsible for performing back-office services for our first clients, including bookkeeping support, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing administration, and general business operations. As our client base and recurring revenue grow, the Operations Manager will help recruit, train, and supervise additional professionals, subject to my approval. The goal is to transition from personally delivering services to managing a scalable team while maintaining responsibility for service quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction. The ideal candidate must be equally comfortable performing detailed back-office work and building and leading a team. We are looking for someone interested in growing with the company and potentially becoming our long-term Head of Operations. Key Responsibilities Phase 1 – Business Setup and Planning Help define the services we can reliably deliver. Recommend staffing requirements and appropriate contractor rates. Develop standard operating procedures and quality-control processes. Recommend software and workflow management tools. Help establish client onboarding procedures. Develop a scalable offshore delivery structure. Phase 2 – Team Recruitment Identify and evaluate qualified bookkeeping, AP/AR, billing, and administrative specialists. Interview prospective contractors. Recommend candidates, compensation, and staffing arrangements. Coordinate paid skills assessments. Build a reliable team of professionals, subject to company owner approval. Phase 3 – Client Service Delivery Manage assigned client workflows and deadlines. Supervise offshore specialists. Monitor work quality and productivity. Coordinate client onboarding and service transitions. Maintain professional client communications. Develop performance reports and operating metrics. Improve efficiency through standardized processes and automation. Required Qualifications At least five years of relevant back-office, BPO, or outsourced business operations experience. opportunities.title: Salesforce/Fonteva Specialist for Association Support
opportunities.description: # Salesforce / Fonteva Specialist — Short-Term Contract We are seeking an experienced Salesforce / Fonteva specialist for a short-term engagement supporting a national professional association. The immediate priority is to assess and stabilize an existing environment supporting membership, examination registration, payments, and related business processes. We need someone who can investigate problems, implement practical fixes, and leave clear documentation that staff can use. ### Scope of work * Review recent incidents affecting registration, purchasing, and related workflows. * Identify root causes and distinguish temporary workarounds from lasting solutions. * Assess relevant Salesforce/Fonteva configuration, custom code, and integrations. * Implement agreed corrective changes using appropriate testing and production release controls. * Establish practical checks before important registration and results-release dates. * Document findings, changes, remaining risks, and recommended next steps in plain language. * Transfer knowledge to internal staff and the IT lead. ### Required experience * Demonstrated, hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting **Fonteva in a live Salesforce environment**. * Strong understanding of Fonteva membership, registration, e-commerce, and payment workflows. * Ability to troubleshoot Salesforce automation, permissions, Apex, and integrations. * Experience working safely across development, testing, and production environments. * Clear communication with non-technical staff and business owners. * Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and provide timely progress updates. Experience with professional associations, certification programs, and candidate-facing services would be an asset. ### Engagement This is a focused, short-term contract with an initial assessment followed by agreed remediation priorities. The specialist will work with the IT lead and relevant departmental owners. Follow-on work may be available. ### To apply Please provide: * A brief summary of your Salesforce and Fonteva experience. * Examples of comparable troubleshooting or stabilization engagements. * Your availability, earliest start date, and hourly or daily rate. * Any relevant Salesforce or Fonteva credentials. **Please highlight your direct Fonteva experience; general Salesforce experience alone will not be sufficient for this engagement.**

opportunities.title: Textile Engineer for Custom Hardware Enclosure -- 2
opportunities.description: Job Title: Technical Textile Engineer / Industrial Pattern Developer – Custom Hardware Enclosure Job Overview: Ti'Kwan'Nae, Ltd Co is seeking an experienced, independent Freelance Textile Engineer / Industrial Pattern Developer to design the proprietary technical fabric components for our Modular Quick-Deployment Enclosure. This product features a custom inflatable pneumatic frame. You will be collaborating directly with our French CAD Engineer to design fabric components that interface seamlessly with a solid mechanical geometry. Core Deliverables: • Develop complete, highly accurate 2D flat-cut textile patterns, layout profiles, and manufacturing-ready nesting strategies based on our frame dimensions. • Engineer designs accommodating harsh weather conditions, including layered fabric seams and tensioning. • Create customized fabric component interfaces, incorporating considerations for sloping and tension/tightening mechanisms. • Deliver finalized production-ready files in standard industry formats (DXF, ASTM, or native apparel CAD files). opportunities.title: Cinematic AI Ad for VoltLink Cables
opportunities.description: Freelance Project: Cinematic AI Advertisement for VoltLink Electrical Cables **Project Budget:** US$200–US$350 **Project Type:** AI Video Production / Product Advertisement **Video Style:** Cinematic, photorealistic, 3D animation **Brand:** VoltLink Electrical Cables ## Project Overview We are seeking a skilled AI video creator or video production specialist to produce a high-quality, cinematic advertisement for VoltLink Electrical Cables, a cable brand manufactured in Turkey and distributed in Jamaica. The video should combine realistic AI-generated footage, 3D animation, professional narration and cinematic transitions to tell the story of electrical safety, quality manufacturing and the importance of reliable electrical cables in Jamaica. The final production should look polished, realistic and suitable for use across social media, digital advertising and other promotional platforms. ## Creative Direction and Video Sequence **1. Opening: From Space to Jamaica** - Begin with a cinematic 3D view of Earth from space. - Zoom smoothly into Jamaica using geographically accurate visuals. - Depict natural hazards such as hurricanes, earthquakes and lightning, alongside Jamaica’s construction and infrastructure development. - Establish why quality construction materials and electrical safety matter. **2. Introducing VoltLink** - Introduce VoltLink cables through dramatic, photorealistic product shots. - Show realistic footage of Jamaican electricians working on electrical installations and construction projects. - Use professional narration to connect reliable electrical cables with quality workmanship and electrical safety. **3. 3D Cable Animation** Create a detailed, photorealistic 3D animation showing a VoltLink cable being stripped apart layer by layer. The animation should clearly reveal: - The outer sheath. - The insulation layer. - The copper conductors. The animation should look technically convincing, with realistic materials, lighting, textures and smooth movement. **4. Manufacturing in Turkey** - Transition to a world map and zoom into Turkey. - Show realistic cable manufacturing footage, including machinery, production lines and quality-control processes. - Communicate that VoltLink is manufactured in Turkey. - Highlight the product’s verified features and certifications, including fire-retardant properties, UL listing and BASEC certification, where applicable to the specific products featured. **5. Closing: Built for Jamaica** - Transition back to Jamaica. - Show quality construction, electrical installations and infrastructure. - End with the authentic VoltLink logo and the official tagline: **“Wired to Serve. Built to Last.”** ## Technical and Creative Requirements - Cinematic, realistic and professional visual quality. - Accurate geographical maps and location transitions. - Photorealistic 3D cable animation. - Professional English narration with a confident commercial tone. - On-screen captions and readable text. - Smooth transitions, dramatic lighting and subtle background music. - Authentic VoltLink logo and brand colours. - Consistent visual storytelling, with footage that matches the narration. - Correct spelling of all brand names and technical terminology. - All product claims and certification references must be accurate and supported by the information provided by the client. ## Deliverables 1. One completed, high-quality promotional video. 2. Final video in MP4 format. 3. A version suitable for social media and digital advertising. 4. Narration, captions, music and sound design included. 5. Reasonable revisions to the completed video, with the number of rounds agreed upon before work begins. 6. Confirmation that all footage, AI-generated assets, music and other materials are licensed for the intended commercial use. ## What We Will Provide - VoltLink logo and available brand assets. - Product and technical information. - Available product images and relevant reference materials. - Verified information regarding certifications and product features. - Additional creative direction as required. ## Ideal Freelancer The ideal candidate should have experience in AI video generation, cinematic advertising, 3D product animation, product visualisation and commercial video editing. Experience creating realistic industrial, electrical, manufacturing or construction-related videos would be an advantage. Please include links to relevant portfolio samples, your proposed production approach, estimated turnaround time and the number of revisions included in your quote. **Budget: US$200–US$350.** Please submit a fixed-price proposal within this range and clearly outline what is included. We are looking for someone who can turn this concept into a visually compelling advertisement that communicates VoltLink’s identity, manufacturing origin and product features with professionalism and realism.

opportunities.title: Develop RFP Hunter: AI-Powered Procurement Platform
opportunities.description: # Build an AI Agent for RFP Discovery, Document Analysis, and Opportunity Alerts I am seeking an experienced AI automation developer to build **RFP Hunter**, a system that continuously finds public procurement opportunities, reads solicitation documents, organizes the information, and alerts users to relevant opportunities. The long-term vision is a national procurement platform where opportunities are free to browse, agencies can upload solicitations, and businesses can subscribe to enhanced notifications and matching services. ## Initial Project: Working AI Sourcing Agent The first priority is a reliable sourcing and document-processing system connected to a searchable website. The system should: **1. Read and organize solicitation documents** - Process web pages, PDFs, Word documents, and scanned documents using OCR where needed. - Extract the project title, agency, location, solicitation number, scope, service category, deadline, mandatory meetings, qualifications, submission instructions, and evaluation criteria. - Produce concise AI summaries with references to the original documents. - Flag missing or uncertain information for review. - Detect duplicate listings while preserving amendments and related documents. **3. Publish searchable opportunities** - Store opportunities in a structured database. - Provide a mobile-friendly website with free public browsing and filters for location, category, keywords, agency, and deadline. - Give each opportunity a shareable page with its summary, key requirements, and official source link. - Include an administrative dashboard to review records, correct information, and monitor system performance. **4. Match opportunities and send alerts** - Let users create profiles describing their services, geographic coverage, and interests. - Match opportunities to those profiles using keyword filters and AI-assisted relevance scoring. - Explain why an opportunity matches. - Send configurable email digests and alerts for important changes without repeatedly sending duplicate notices. ## Future Platform Features Please price these separately from the initial sourcing agent: - Verified agency accounts for uploading and updating solicitations. - AI extraction from agency-uploaded documents, with review before publication. - Searchable company profiles and teaming partner discovery. - Premium subscriptions for advanced alerts, matching, and team features. - Advertising, sponsorships, and clearly labeled featured listings. - A conversational search assistant that answers questions using collected solicitation documents and cites its sources. opportunities.title: Social Media Presenter for Jewellery Brand
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a casual and friendly presenter to showcase our necklaces and pendants, keyrings and cufflinks on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Key Responsibilities: - Presenting jewellery in a casual, friendly manner. - Creating content around seasonal collections, behind-the-scenes, and customer testimonials. - Being the face of our brand for Social media . Ideal Skills: - Experience in front of the camera. - Engaging personality. - Experience with Instagram and social media content creation. We're looking for a reliable UGC content creator to produce short-form videos (15–30 seconds) for my social channels. We do the planning: you’ll get each video idea or brief, plus the jewellery, props and anything else you need to film it, so your focus is on bringing it to life on camera in a natural, relatable way. Content centres on our handcrafted coin jewellery and the stories behind it- the coins in the jewellery being 'as old as them, fact and memories of years gone by', including birthdays, anniversaries and personalised gifts with real meaning. Consistency matters most to us. We're looking for someone who can deliver the agreed number of videos every week reliably, hit the deadlines we set together, and stay responsive on WhatsApp or DM so we can plan ahead. Videos should be well lit, clearly show the product, and be filmed in portrait for Reels and TikTok- all the things you already know and deliver.

opportunities.title: Copy-Paste Publishing Assistant(s) for a Nonprofit — 200 Listings/Day Catch-Up, Then Ongoing All Summer (Fully Prepared Content, Manual Only)
opportunities.description: Copy-Paste Publishing Assistant(s) for a Nonprofit — 200 Listings/Day Catch-Up, Then Ongoing All Summer (Fully Prepared Content, Manual Only) Category / skills: Data Entry, Virtual Assistant, Copy Typing Description: We're a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit that arranges services for seniors, veterans, disabled neighbors, and families facing hardship. We've built an internal system that automatically writes a recruiting listing for every neighbor who needs help — privacy-screened, fully composed, ready to go. What we need is a human publishing partner (individual or small team) who copies each prepared listing from our private dashboard and pastes it onto a well-known volunteer-recruitment website, by hand. Why by hand? Compliance. The destination website's terms require listings to be reviewed and published by a real person. So this role is 100% manual and that's non-negotiable: no bots, no scrapers, no browser automation, no macros, no scripts — ever. Any automation ends the engagement immediately. ** You are the human in the middle; that's the entire point of the role. ** The task, precisely. Each listing on the destination site is a 5-page form with about 25 fields (title, description, location, time commitment, screening questions, category tags, etc.). Sounds heavy — it isn't: We supply every field. Each card on our dashboard shows the exact text for all 25 fields, page by page, in the same order as the form. You never write, guess, or improvise anything. ~21 of the 25 fields are identical every time. The site has a "duplicate listing" feature — after your first listing, you duplicate and change only what's unique: the title (each carries its own reference code that must be pasted exactly, never shortened), the description, the city, and the photo. The photo is one click. Our dashboard generates a custom image per listing — click download, upload to the form, done. After publishing, click "Mark posted ✓" on our dashboard. Our system verifies it automatically — that's how completed work is counted. With rhythm, each listing takes 2–4 minutes: duplicate → paste title → paste description → set city → download/upload photo → publish → mark posted. The volume, in two phases: Phase 1 — Catch-up: ~3,000 listings at ~200/day (roughly 3 weeks). This clears our 90-day backlog of neighbors waiting for help. Phase 2 — Ongoing: ~25–50/day for the rest of the summer at least, as new requests arrive daily. Strong Phase 1 performers get first claim on this follow-up project. Teams welcome. 200/day is a full focused day for one person — so if you run a small team, our dashboard is built for it: each teammate types their name, claims a batch of listings with one click, and those listings leave everyone else's queue. Assignments are exclusive, so two people can never post the same listing. You split the day's 200 however you like. What this is NOT: no writing, no research, no calls, no customer contact, no handling of personal data (our system strips all of that before you ever see a listing). Accuracy beats speed — we spot-check, and reference codes must match character-for-character. Access: you'll be invited to the destination site under our organization's account with your own login, plus a password link to our dashboard. Nothing to install. Pay & structure: Quote us your flat daily rate for 200 completed listings (a "completed listing" = published on the site and marked posted on our dashboard, where it's verified automatically; partial days pro-rated). Also quote your rate for the Phase 2 maintenance pace (25–50/day). We start with a small paid trial batch of 10 listings to confirm fit before awarding the ongoing work. To apply: start your proposal with the word MOWER so we know you read this. Then: (1) Your high-volume form/data-entry experience — where? (2) Confirm in your own words that this must be done entirely by hand, no automation of any kind. (3) Your flat rate for one day of 200 completed listings, your Phase 2 rate, and whether you're solo or a team (how many people, hours, timezone).

opportunities.title: Resolve WordPress Crawl Errors (Google flagged destination error but website is fully live)
opportunities.description: Google Ads has paused every campaign on the grounds of “destination error – URL not working,” yet the site loads perfectly for users and my host can’t see any server-side fault. Google’s own crawl test, however, is failing for the entire site. I need an experienced WordPress troubleshooter who can dig into the core of the problem, pinpoint why Googlebot cannot render the site, and implement a clean fix. No recent changes have been deployed, and the site is largely multimedia-driven (images and videos embedded throughout), so I’m looking for someone who understands how themes, plugins, robots.txt, sitemaps, caching layers, CDNs, and core web vitals interplay with Google’s crawler. Deliverables • Identify the exact crawl issue and provide a brief report outlining the root cause. • Apply the necessary code, configuration, or server-side adjustments to resolve it. • Validate the repair by getting the URL Inspection tool in Search Console to return “URL is on Google” and reinstate campaign eligibility. Acceptance will be based on a successful crawl test screenshot and restoration of ad delivery status.

opportunities.title: Hiring Freelance 3D Developer / Team – Interactive Maritime Equipment Training Platform
opportunities.description: Project: Interactive 3D Maritime Equipment Training Platform We are seeking an experienced freelance 3D Developer, Interactive Simulation Specialist, or small development team for an upcoming maritime technical training project in India. Our Objective: We intend to develop an interactive, web-based 3D training platform focused on shipboard machinery, marine automation, monitoring, and safety systems. Equipment and Systems (Indicative Scope): Boiler Systems Inert Gas (IG) Systems Purifiers Oily Water Separators (OWS) Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment (ODME) Oil Mist Detectors (OMD) Alarm Monitoring Systems Cargo Monitoring Systems Fire Detection Systems Fire Suppression Systems Safety & Shutdown Systems Expected Development Capabilities: Realistic 3D modeling of marine equipment and machinery Interactive 3D visualization with rotation, zoom, and component exploration Clickable components displaying equipment names, functions, and technical information Equipment operation and process-flow animations, where required Web-based interactive training modules Potential integration of troubleshooting scenarios, assessments, and additional training features Preferred Technical Skills: Blender, Three.js, WebGL, React Three Fiber, Unity, Unreal Engine, 3D Modeling, Industrial Simulation, and Interactive Web Development. Who We Are Looking For We prefer freelancers or development teams with proven experience in interactive 3D applications, industrial equipment visualization, technical training simulations, or similar projects. Experience in maritime, marine engineering, or industrial automation projects would be an advantage. Important – Current Stage of the Project At this stage, we are identifying and shortlisting technically capable freelancers or teams. The final project scope, equipment selection, technical specifications, development approach, budget, and timeline will be discussed and finalized directly with our management team. Equipment photographs, engineering drawings, and technical reference materials may be provided during subsequent discussions. Interested Candidates Should Share: Portfolio with relevant completed projects. Live demonstrations of interactive 3D applications, if available. Experience in industrial equipment modeling or training simulations. Technologies and development tools used. Ability to handle a complete project involving multiple equipment training modules. Availability for an online technical discussion with our management team. Location Preference: India-based freelancers or development teams preferred. We are looking for a technically capable and reliable development partner for a potentially larger, long-term project.

opportunities.title: Python Exam Figure Generator Service
opportunities.description: We publish online mock tests for government exams (SSC, Railway) in English and Hindi. Today our team draws every question figure by hand. We need a Python service that draws them automatically from JSON, so our AI question generator can request a figure for each new question. The full specification is in the attached PDF (Project Brief). Please read it before bidding. BUILT WITH CLAUDE Designed to be completed by one developer using Claude (Claude Code) and free open-source Python libraries only: no paid software, no hand drawing, no external services. The sample zip includes CLAUDE.md (instructions for Claude Code) and PROJECT_SPEC.md (full spec in Markdown). All acceptance checks are automated. WHAT YOU WILL BUILD - A Python 3.10+ renderer: JSON in, clean print-quality SVG and PNG out, in our house style. - The JSON describes meaning, not coordinates ("tangent from P touching at R and S", "all A are B", "triangle with angles 30, 60, 90"). Your code works out every position. This needs real geometry: tangents, inscribed circles, triangles from sides and angles, 3D solids drawn in 2D. - A label placer: no label may ever touch a line, an arc or another label, even in crowded figures. This is checked by an automated test. - English and Hindi (Devanagari) labels, with correct conjunct shaping in SVG and PNG. - A JSON Schema per figure type, with separate errors for invalid input, an impossible figure and an unknown figure type. - Deterministic output: the same input always gives byte-identical files. - A REST API with an API key, packaged with Docker, plus a step-by-step deployment guide. - A JSON input for each of our 525 reference figures, plus a side-by-side review page (our figure next to yours). FIGURE TYPES (525 figures) Reasoning: Direction Sense (60), Non-Verbal Venn (53), Finding Missing Elements (44), Logical Venn (41), Coding-Decoding (37), Seating Arrangement (30), Series (17), Syllogism (14), Classification (3) Quant: Circle (65), Area (38), Volume (34), Triangles (26), Data Interpretation charts (12), Quadrilateral (16), Height & Distance (12), Lines & Angles (11), Coordinate Geometry (10), Mixture (2) 34 sample figures are attached. The full set (with manifest and errata) is shared after award. MILESTONES (quote a price and duration for each) M1 Core system and pilot (134 figures): core engine, label placer, schema framework, API, Docker, review page, test suite + Logical Venn, Non-Verbal Venn, Syllogism, Triangles M2 Reasoning and charts (205 figures): Seating Arrangement, Classification, Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding, Series, Finding Missing Elements, DI charts, Mixture M3 Geometry and handover (186 figures): Lines & Angles, Coordinate Geometry, Circle, Quadrilateral, Height & Distance, Area, Volume, final Docker package and deployment guide M1 is also the pilot. We release M2 and M3 to the same freelancer only if M1 is accepted. ACCEPTANCE Every figure in the milestone approved on the review page, the delivered zip builds with Docker and all tests pass (including the label-clearance and determinism checks), schemas and docs complete. Code is delivered as a zip through Freelancer. Final milestone: the API starts by following your deployment guide. All code and rights transfer to us on payment. No GPL or AGPL dependencies. HOW TO BID Start your proposal with the word FIGURE. Others will not be considered. Please include: 1. Links or screenshots of diagram, geometry or chart rendering you have built in code. 2. How you will keep labels clear of lines (the algorithm). 3. How you will render Devanagari correctly in SVG and PNG. 4. Your Python libraries, and how you will make the output byte-identical. 5. Your price and duration for each milestone, M1 to M3. 6. Confirmation that you accept the pilot-first arrangement. 7. Confirmation that you will build it with Claude Code and free open-source libraries only.

opportunities.title: Tsuba & Menuki CAD Modeling
opportunities.description: I have a pair of AI-generated concept images that show exactly how I want a Japanese sword tsuba and matching menuki to look. Your task is to turn those visuals into clean, manufacture-ready 3D CAD models. • Source material – Two high-resolution reference images (one for the tsuba, one for the menuki) featuring traditional Japanese patterns exactly as I want them carved or embossed. – A dimension sheet with the precise outer, inner, and thickness measurements for both pieces. No need to estimate; just follow the numbers I supply. • Your work – Recreate every motif from the images with faithful detail, ensuring the patterns wrap or flow naturally around each part. – Build solid, watertight models suitable for CNC machining or lost-wax casting. Undercuts, relief depth, and edge fillets must match the functional realities of sword fittings. – Deliver the final geometry in STEP format. You are welcome to work in Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino, or any other software as long as the exported STEP files open cleanly. • Acceptance criteria 1. Geometry passes a solid integrity check (no open edges or self-intersections). 2. All supplied dimensions are held to ±0.05 mm. 3. Decorative features match the reference images when overlaid. 4. I can import the STEP files and immediately generate toolpaths without repair. If revisions are needed to hit these points, I’ll provide concise notes and expect updated files.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40777769, publicado hace 10 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: AUD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Desarrollador Full Stack Senior para Sitios Web y Crm Personalizados
opportunities.description: Buscamos un Desarrollador Full Stack Senior con amplia experiencia en programación web, diseño ux/ui y desarrollo de crm personalizados. Este profesional será clave para transformar ideas de negocio en plataformas digitales completas, modernas, intuitivas, funcionales y escalables, participando desde la conceptualización hasta la implementación. El proyecto incluye el desarrollo de 4 plataformas: dos sitios web corporativos modernos y responsive con funcionalidades específicas, y dos CRM personalizados para la gestión comercial, contactos, clientes, procesos internos y automatizaciones. Se requiere la integración entre las webs y sus respectivos CRM para la captación de leads, administración de información y seguimiento, además de la incorporación de herramientas de inteligencia artificial, integraciones externas y funcionalidades avanzadas. Las responsabilidades abarcan comprender nuestras necesidades, proponer soluciones tecnológicas, diseñar interfaces, definir la arquitectura, desarrollar, realizar pruebas exhaustivas, implementar y documentar todas las aplicaciones. Valoramos la autonomía, la creatividad, el criterio técnico y la capacidad de aportar mejoras significativas a las ideas originales. Se busca establecer una relación profesional de largo plazo para futuros desarrollos, mejoras y mantenimiento continuo. Es indispensable que el código fuente, los accesos y toda la documentación queden bajo la propiedad y el control de nuestra empresa. opportunities.title: Digital Marketing
opportunities.description: Busco especialista en Marketing Digital, Publicidad y Lanzamiento de Marca Estoy buscando un profesional freelance con experiencia en marketing digital que se encargue de desarrollar y ejecutar una estrategia integral de publicidad y marketing para un nuevo proyecto empresarial. Busco a una persona capaz de acompañarme en el lanzamiento del proyecto y ayudarme a posicionarlo en el mercado, conseguir visibilidad y atraer potenciales clientes. Funciones principales: - Estrategia de marketing: diseñar un plan de lanzamiento y crecimiento. - Publicidad digital: crear y gestionar campañas en Instagram, Facebook, Google Ads y otras plataformas relevantes. - Captación de clientes: desarrollar estrategias para atraer usuarios y generar conversiones. - Redes sociales: planificar y gestionar contenidos profesionales. - Creación de anuncios: elaborar textos publicitarios, creatividades y material promocional. - Posicionamiento de marca: desarrollar una imagen profesional y una comunicación diferenciada. - Análisis de resultados: medir el rendimiento de las campañas y optimizar la inversión publicitaria. Perfil que busco: - Experiencia demostrable en lanzamientos de marcas o proyectos empresariales. - Conocimientos sólidos de publicidad digital y captación de clientes. - Capacidad para desarrollar y ejecutar una estrategia completa, no solamente publicar en redes sociales. - Iniciativa, creatividad y visión comercial. - Portfolio con ejemplos de trabajos anteriores y resultados obtenidos. Para presentar tu propuesta: Indica tu experiencia, los servicios que puedes ofrecer, ejemplos de campañas realizadas, tu metodología de trabajo y tus honorarios. Busco una colaboración profesional, con posibilidad de continuidad a largo plazo si los resultados son satisfactorios. Por motivos de confidencialidad, los detalles del proyecto se compartirán directamente con los candidatos seleccionados. Preferiblemente personas de VENEZUELA.

opportunities.title: Asistente Administrativa Gestión Integral
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo remoto para mantener mi operación diaria organizada y sin sobresaltos. El trabajo gira en torno a tres frentes muy concretos: • Gestión de correos: filtrar, priorizar y responder mensajes de clientes, del equipo interno y de proveedores, dejando claras etiquetas y seguimientos en Gmail/Outlook. • Coordinación de agenda: agendar reuniones, reprogramar citas y prevenir solapamientos en Google Calendar y Outlook, notificando a las partes implicadas con antelación. • Registro de datos: actualizar hojas de cálculo, pequeños reportes y archivos compartidos en Excel / Sheets, asegurando exactitud y formato uniforme. Para desenvolverte con soltura necesitarás dominio cotidiano de Microsoft Office Suite y Google Workspace. Entrego acceso a las cuentas, reglas de clasificación de correo y un calendario maestro; espero a cambio bandeja al día, citas confirmadas y bases de datos impecables. Valoro respuestas ágiles (dentro de la jornada) y atención al detalle: errores mínimos y comunicación clara cuando surjan dudas. Si te encanta organizar, sabes priorizar y disfrutas manteniendo todo en orden, me encantará contar contigo.

opportunities.title: Vídeo Lanzamiento para Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando el lanzamiento de un nuevo producto y necesito un vídeo promocional de entre 1 y 3 minutos optimizado para redes sociales. Qué busco: • Conceptualización creativa: guion breve y storyboard que destaquen valor y diferencial del producto desde el primer segundo. • Producción y edición: manejo de imágenes o filmaciones propias/stock, motion graphics sutiles y ritmo dinámico que retenga la atención en feed y stories. • Elementos clave para social media: música libre de derechos, textos sobreimpresos y subtítulos en español, además de versión vertical (9:16) y horizontal (16:9). • Entregables finales: archivo MP4 listo para publicar, fuente editable del proyecto (Premiere, Final Cut o After Effects) y miniatura atractiva. Valoraría experiencia previa en lanzamientos de producto y un portafolio que muestre trabajos con resultados medibles en Instagram, TikTok o Facebook. Indícame tu plazo estimado y cualquier necesidad técnica o de material adicional para arrancar.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador/a freelance B2B — Campaña piloto de 100 bares en Barcelona
opportunities.description: ROTT Cooling, empresa especializada en refrigeración profesional para hostelería, busca un/a teleoperador/a freelance para una campaña piloto de prospección comercial. Trabajo a realizar: - Contactar telefónicamente con 100 bares y cervecerías del Vallès utilizando una base de datos facilitada por ROTT Cooling. - Presentar un botellero profesional INOX de 184 litros, con precio de lanzamiento de 449 € + IVA. - Identificar al propietario o responsable de compras. - Consultar si desea recibir información por WhatsApp o email. - Registrar los resultados de cada contacto y las solicitudes de información. Requisitos: - Experiencia en llamadas comerciales B2B en España. - Castellano fluido; catalán valorable. - Disponibilidad en horario comercial español. Condiciones: Proyecto inicial de 15–20 horas, sujeto a presupuesto y volumen real de llamadas. Trabajo remoto. Posibilidad de continuidad con aproximadamente 1000 establecimientos adicionales si la prueba funciona. Buscamos una persona con experiencia real en prospección, no un servicio de call center completo.

opportunities.title: App de Estudio para Ciudadanía EEUU
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que ayude a futuros ciudadanos de Estados Unidos a estudiar y practicar todo el proceso de naturalización con una dinámica similar a Duolingo. El proyecto debe cubrir tanto iOS como Android y mantenerse fiel a tres pilares esenciales: • Lecciones interactivas: ejercicios de speaking y writing guiados, tarjetas de memoria para las 128 preguntas oficiales de civics y pequeños retos gamificados que mantengan la motivación diaria. • Simulaciones de entrevista: un flujo que recree la entrevista real, con reconocimiento de voz, temporizador y retroalimentación automática para que el usuario sepa qué mejorar. • Evaluaciones de progreso: paneles que muestren estadísticas, rachas, badges y recomendaciones de estudio personalizadas. Necesito un equipo o desarrollador con experiencia comprobable en apps educativas, gamificación y publicación en App Store/Google Play. El alcance incluye: – Diseño de UX/UI alineado con la estética “Duolingo-like”. – Desarrollo completo de front-end (Flutter, React Native o nativo; estoy abierto a propuestas) y back-end con autenticación, almacenamiento seguro y analíticas. – Integración de bases de datos oficiales de USCIS para el civics test. – Pruebas unitarias y de usabilidad, además de soporte para la primera publicación en ambas tiendas. –Entregar Código fuente completo (frontend + backend) Acceso total al repositorio (GitHub o similar) Sin dependencias ocultas y un pequeño manual de administración de contenidos. Indica en tu propuesta tu stack sugerido, ejemplos de apps similares que hayas publicado y el cronograma estimado para un MVP funcional. Estoy listo para empezar tan pronto encontremos el ajuste perfecto.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que ayude a futuros ciudadanos de Estados Unidos a estudiar y practicar todo el proceso de naturalización con una dinámica similar a Duolingo. Necesito un equipo o desarrollador con experiencia comprobable en apps educativas, gamificación y publicación en App Store/Google Play. El alcance incluye: – Diseño de UX/UI alineado con la estética “Duolingo-like”. – Desarrollo completo de front-end (Flutter, React Native o nativo; estoy abierto a propuestas) y back-end con autenticación, almacenamiento seguro y analíticas. – Integración de bases de datos oficiales de USCIS para el civics test. – Pruebas unitarias y de usabilidad, además de soporte para la primera publicación en ambas tiendas. –Entregar Código fuente completo (frontend + backend) Acceso total al repositorio (GitHub o similar) Sin dependencias ocultas y un pequeño manual de administración de contenidos. opportunities.title: Diseño de Logos y Flyers
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar, en Photoshop, un logo y un flyer que representen un negocio de carácter general. Ambos diseños deben entregarse en un único idioma, pero es importante que el estilo sea fácilmente adaptable a versiones multilingües en el futuro. Requiero: • Logo en alta resolución (PNG, JPG y archivo fuente PSD). • Flyer vertical y horizontal (A4 y formato para redes), también con su PSD editable. • Breve animación o versión en video de máximo 10 s que muestre el logo y el flyer de forma dinámica para redes sociales. El concepto deberá transmitir profesionalidad y versatilidad, listo para usarse tanto en material impreso como digital. Agradeceré que en la propuesta se mencione experiencia previa combinando diseño estático y video, así como dominio de varios idiomas, aunque en esta fase solo se entregue la variante en un idioma.
